title: API - See Financial Data OFF: work order document response carries no pricing
custom_preconds:
1. A test user whose role has the “See Financial Data” toggle turned OFF (Settings, then Roles & Permissions, open the role, turn the “See Financial Data” toggle off), and that user's authenticated session. For a clean result use a Full View role with only that toggle off, so nothing else is what removes the pricing.

2. A second user whose role has “See Financial Data” ON, to run the same request as a control.

3. A work order that has been invoiced (status Invoiced or Paid), so its document response carries pricing — part sell prices, labour, tax, and a total. A work order that has not been invoiced yet does not return this document.
custom_steps:
1. As the See-Financial-Data-OFF user, call the work order's document render endpoint — the line-detail document path that the See-Financial-Data enforcement covers (task SV-7484). On the current build this is the invoice/estimate document render for the work order: GET /api/invoices/preview?invoice_id=<the work order's invoice_id>&type=pdf. Also fetch it with type=html to inspect the rendered content, because the PDF itself has no text layer to search.

2. Read the full response body.

3. Inspect the response — every line and the document totals — for any financial data: sellPrice, cost, margin, labour rate, tax, total, or any money amount.

4. Control: send the exact same request as the See-Financial-Data-ON user and inspect that response too.
custom_expected:
1. For the See-Financial-Data-OFF user, the response carries NO financial data of any kind — no sellPrice, cost or margin values, no dollar amounts, no labour rates, no tax and no totals — on every line and for the document as a whole.

2. Control: the same request as the See-Financial-Data-ON user DOES return the pricing, confirming the data exists on the work order and only the permission removes it from the response.

This is the expected behaviour as per epic SV-7388 (Custom Roles and Permissions), story SV-7523 (Permission: See Financial Data — “OFF: all financial data hidden across every page”) and task SV-7484 ([CRP-BE-09] seeFinancialData enforcement chokepoint — acceptance: a Fin-OFF user gets payloads with no sellPrice/cost/margin keys, including the PDF paths), read on 10 September 2026.

Last checked against the staging build on 9/10/2026.

AUTOMATION: READY
